name: MMAU
intro: MMAU 是一个大规模多任务音频理解与推理 benchmark，用于评估音频语言模型在语音、环境声和音乐上的高级感知、信息抽取和复杂推理能力。它包含 10,000 道基于精心筛选音频并经专家标注与复核的多选题，覆盖 27 类任务。
build_method: 七步专家策展, 人工标注, GPT-4选项增强
task_type: 音频理解, 音频推理
eval_feature: 音频推理, 信息抽取, 27项技能, 领域知识
build_method_en: Seven-step Expert Curation, Human Annotation, GPT-4 Option Augmentation
eval_feature_en: Audio reasoning, Information extraction, 27 skills, Domain knowledge
intro_en: MMAU is a massive multi-task audio understanding and reasoning benchmark for evaluating audio-language models on advanced perception, information extraction, and complex reasoning over speech, environmental sounds, and music. It contains 10,000 expert-annotated and reviewed multiple-choice questions grounded in carefully selected audio across 27 tasks.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select 13 speech, sound, and music corpora"] --> B["Curate 90 candidate tasks down to 27"]
    B --> C["Select plausible audio and expert-author QA pairs"]
    C --> D["Use a separate expert team to filter ambiguous or low-quality items"]
    D --> E["Use GPT-4 to add context-aware distractor options"]
    E --> F["Expert-review answers, options, task tags, and skill tags"]
    F --> G["Reduce 11,000 annotated pairs to 10,000 final MCQs"]
    G --> H["Balance three domains and 27 tasks"]
    H --> I["Split 1,000 test-mini and 9,000 main test questions"]
    I --> J["Report multiple-choice accuracy by domain and overall"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择13个语音、声音和音乐语料库"] --> B["将90个候选任务策展为27个任务"]
    B --> C["选择合适音频并由专家编写问答"]
    C --> D["由独立专家团队过滤歧义或低质量样本"]
    D --> E["用GPT-4增加基于上下文的干扰选项"]
    E --> F["由专家复核答案、选项、任务和技能标签"]
    F --> G["将11,000个标注对缩减为10,000道最终多选题"]
    G --> H["平衡三个领域与27类任务"]
    H --> I["拆分1,000题小测试集和9,000题主测试集"]
    I --> J["按领域与整体报告多选准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.19168 Section 3.2 and Appendix C. The diagram preserves the paper's seven named stages, 13 source corpora, preference for real audio, 90-to-27 task curation, expert QA annotation, independent expert filtering, GPT-4 context-aware option augmentation, final task and skill tagging, the exact 11,000 minus 800 minus 200 equals 10,000 accounting, balancing across speech, sound, music, and 27 tasks, the 1,000 plus 9,000 split, and multiple-choice accuracy reporting.
